Class MathContext

java.lang.Object
net.murat.math.MathContext
public final class MathContext extends Object
License GPLv3

Global scratchpad for zero-allocation mathematics in the ray tracing loop.

This class provides pre-allocated, mutable vector and point instances to prevent massive heap allocation and GC overhead during the single-threaded rendering process.
